en: This is a vintage postcard. The front features a colorized photo of a rural scene in Stockvik, Sundsvall, with cows grazing on grass, a few people walking on a road, and several wooden houses surrounded by trees. The artwork is bordered on the bottom by the printed title and handwritten message. The reverse side has handwritten text in Swedish, formal address lines, and the printed word 'BREFKORT' with French translation 'Carte postale'.
